transcript.text: Hi everyone. We've got the offline-sync engine production rollout coming up this Wednesday. Before I record the rollout plan, I need final status from each of the required functions: mobile engineering, reliability, customer support, and privacy. Let's go around and get everyone's final status. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important. While reviewing a compatibility report for an unrelated mobile release this morning, I confirmed that Android versions below 8.5 emit the legacy tombstone format that the new sync engine cannot reconcile. I haven't updated the rollout document yet because the report was only completed this morning, but this could affect our Android audience for the Wednesday rollout.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share some measurements I took during a traffic replay on the production sync queue. A rollout above 5 percent would exceed the queue's safe processing margin. I also confirmed that reliability needs a 30-minute observation period after enabling the flag before we proceed further. I haven't added these numbers to the release ticket yet, but they're critical for the rollout plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share something I found while preparing support coverage. The Aurora and Helix enterprise accounts have active offline workflows confirmed from current support cases, and they must be excluded from the first rollout until their account teams complete a separate acceptance check. I haven't posted this account list in the release channel yet.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to give my privacy status, and there's a critical finding. In a privacy review I completed this afternoon, I confirmed that the sync payload can carry location metadata. The first rollout must disable location metadata for every user until the data-use review is closed. This finding isn't in the privacy tracking system yet because the review just finished minutes ago, but it's a blocker for the rollout plan if location metadata isn't disabled.
transcript.speaker: A5
